title: Distribution Identifier Type
description: Platform-specific identifier types for collection distribution. Maps a collection to its presence on specific platforms, enabling cross-seller matching. The `instagram_account_id`, `instagram_handle`, `facebook_page_id`, `facebook_page_handle`, `snapchat_profile_id`, `snapchat_handle`, `x_user_id` and `x_handle` values were added in AdCP 3.3.

enumDescriptions.youtube_channel_id: YouTube channel ID. Preferred canonical identifier for YouTube channels; handles and URLs are discovery aliases that should resolve to this when possible.
enumDescriptions.youtube_channel_handle: YouTube channel handle such as @example. Useful as a discovery alias; channel ID is preferred for canonical matching.
enumDescriptions.youtube_channel_url: YouTube channel URL such as https://www.youtube.com/@example or https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC.... Useful as a discovery alias; channel ID is preferred for canonical matching.
enumDescriptions.youtube_playlist_id: YouTube playlist ID (for series within a channel)
enumDescriptions.platform_channel_id: Stable channel identifier assigned by the platform named in the enclosing distribution's publisher_domain. Use as the portable fallback when no platform-specific identifier type exists; identity is the tuple (publisher_domain, value), so this type is only meaningful inside a distribution entry and MUST NOT appear in bare {type, value} contexts (distribution_ids sources, exclude filters). Use the platform's stable catalog identifier, not an EPG position number — hosts renumber lineups.
enumDescriptions.instagram_account_id: Instagram account ID: the stable numeric user ID the platform's APIs return. Preferred canonical identifier for Instagram accounts; handles are discovery aliases that should resolve to this when possible.
enumDescriptions.instagram_handle: Instagram username such as @example. Useful as a discovery alias; the account ID is preferred for canonical matching.
enumDescriptions.facebook_page_id: Facebook Page ID. Preferred canonical identifier for Facebook Pages; handles are discovery aliases that should resolve to this when possible.
enumDescriptions.facebook_page_handle: Facebook Page username (vanity name) such as @example. Useful as a discovery alias; the Page ID is preferred for canonical matching.
enumDescriptions.snapchat_profile_id: Snapchat Public Profile ID. Preferred canonical identifier for Snapchat Public Profiles; handles are discovery aliases that should resolve to this when possible.
enumDescriptions.snapchat_handle: Snapchat username such as @example. Useful as a discovery alias; the profile ID is preferred for canonical matching.
enumDescriptions.x_user_id: X (formerly Twitter) numeric user ID. Preferred canonical identifier for X accounts; handles are discovery aliases that should resolve to this when possible.
enumDescriptions.x_handle: X (formerly Twitter) username such as @example. Useful as a discovery alias; the user ID is preferred for canonical matching.
enumDescriptions.gracenote_id: Gracenote TMS ID — industry standard for TV metadata
enumDescriptions.eidr_id: EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry) — ISO 10528 for audiovisual content
